title: Ice Mage and Chain Warrior
description: A male warrior in dark blue armor swings a broken chain weapon while shattering a sheet of ice, standing beside a female horned mage in ornate white and silver robes who casts a glowing spell. They stand on a snowy rocky outcrop above a vast frozen tundra with cracked ice, distant mountains, and a colorful aurora in the sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene set in a vast arctic landscape with cracked glowing ice and distant snow-covered mountains under a bright blue sky with vibrant aurora borealis. In the foreground, a rugged male warrior in dark blue and black armor dynamically swings a broken metal chain, shattering ice, while a beautiful female tiefling mage with large curved horns, wearing ornate flowing white and silver robes, casts a powerful purple and white magical spell. Dynamic action, magical particles and ice shards flying, epic composition, highly detailed digital painting.
